messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick sync — prepping Meridian EBR for next Wed. Need to lock slides, exec asks, and confirm renewal risk level. Can folks drop updates here by EOD Fri?

Jon Ramirez: On slides — I have the usage + SLA page almost done. Will upload v1 by tomorrow noon. Need someone to review the churn/RR graph. :eyes:

Ravi Gupta: I'll take the churn/RR graph. Also pulling onboarding completion numbers from Gainsight. ETA Friday 11am.

Claire Chen: Heads-up: enablement team wants a 10-min segment to demo the new self-serve runbook. We should decide whether that goes to the exec readout or the ops section.

Aisha Patel: Good catch. I think ops section is better (execs prefer top-line). Claire — can you prepare a 1-slide summary and a 1-slide demo screenshot?

Claire Chen: Yep, will do. Also capture enablement asks (recommended training cadence + customer health play).

Jon Ramirez: Uploaded draft slides here: https://drive.redwood/meridian/ebr/v1 (comments enabled). Please annotate.

Ravi Gupta: Adding onboarding metrics below — feel free to copy for slide: 
- Seats provisioned: 1,250
- Active MAUs (last 30d): 870
- Onboarding completion (core flows): 78%
- Avg time-to-first-success: 6.3 days

Aisha Patel: Thanks Ravi. For renewal risk — current CSAT trend is flat but usage dip among power users in 2 accounts. I’m putting Meridian at Amber risk (early warning). Need mitigation plan: 1) targeted enablement, 2) exec touchpoint, 3) promo for usage incentives.

Jon Ramirez: Can you draft a short exec ask for the CSM to present? Something like: "Recommend a 30-min exec sync to discuss strategic roadmap alignment + approval for a short-term credits pilot."

Aisha Patel: Yes — drafting now. Will post below for edit.

Sam (CS-bot): Reminder: EBR template deadline in 3 days. Auto-check will flag missing exec asks and slide count > 12.

Aisha Patel: Draft exec ask: 
---
We recommend a 30-minute strategic sync between Meridian execs and Redwood leadership to: 
1) Review usage trends and product roadmap alignment for Q3; 
2) Approve a 6-week credits pilot targeted at drop-off cohorts; 
3) Confirm support for enablement cadence and a technical deep-dive session.
---
Pls edit.

Ravi Gupta: Minor wording: change "6-week credits pilot" to "6-week usage credits pilot" and add expected success metric: "+10% active usage in cohort".

Claire Chen: Add enablement ask: "commit to 2x 60-min customer workshops in the next quarter".

Aisha Patel: Updated. Final ask below — please sign off by EOD Fri.

Jon Ramirez: Signed off from slide/content side. Will reduce slide count to 11.

Ravi Gupta: Signed off on metrics and onboarding slides.

Claire Chen: Signed off on enablement slides. Will attach walkthrough GIF.

Aisha Patel: Action items recap: 
- Jon: upload final slide deck (due Mon 9am) 
- Ravi: supply final onboarding numbers & annotated churn graph (due Fri 11am) 
- Claire: 1-slide enablement summary + demo screenshot (due Fri 4pm) 
- CSM (Samira): confirm exec availability and post meeting invite (due Mon EOD) 
- Aisha: finalize exec ask doc and coordinate runbook demo (due Mon 3pm)

Sam (CS-bot): Task created: #EBR-Meridian - assigned to Aisha/Jon/Ravi/Claire/Samira, due Mon.

Jon Ramirez: One more thing — capture customer feedback themes in slide 9 (three bullets max). I have raw quotes; who wants to do a short synthesis?

Ravi Gupta: I can synthesize quotes into 3 themes by Fri.

Aisha Patel: Perfect. Also note renewal rep will want a separate pre-EBR risk huddle if anything moves to Red. Let's keep an eye on the two power-user accounts I flagged.

Claire Chen: I'll prep a short playbook for the two accounts (support + enablement + product triage).

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — this is actionable. If anyone hits blockers, ping me. :thumbsup:
